g.text: Patched Effect 4.0.0 · Workers Observability cpuTimeMs · same wnam location hint
Left: largest-N medians with Q1–Q3; 5–7 observed baseline pairs. Ratios include each shape's payload work.
Right: separate composition-only model ranges across calibration copies; actual bars show median and Q1–Q3.
Schema and no-op yields can consume CPU with zero marginal interpreter evaluations. Missing telemetry is never imputed.
